spans.s: Vivāha (EI 12), ‘one whose vehicle is the bird’; i. e. Viṣṇu.
vivāha (CII 1), marriage of a daughter; cf. āvāha which means the marriage of a son.
vivāha-kara, cf. Tamil kaṇṇāla-kkāṇan (EI 28), the marriage fee; cf. vivāha-ppaṇam.
vivāha-paṇa, cf. vivāha-ppaṇam (SITI), same as kaṇṇāla-kkāṇam; a tax on marriage.
vivīta (HRS), royal dues collected by the superintendent of pastures, as suggested by the Arthaśāstra.
Vivīt-ādhyakṣa (EI 28), known from the Arthaśāstra; officer in charge of the pasture land. Cf. Vrajabhūmika.
vivāha-ppaṇam (SITI), Sanskrit-Tamil; marriage fee; cf. kaṇṇāla-kkāṇam.
